Reachable keeps the content of a declarative shadow root

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var optionsJson = "{\"hidden_content\":\"Reachable\"}";
        var options = JsonUtil.fromJson(optionsJson, ConversionOptions.class);
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<div><template shadowrootmode=\"open\"><p>shadow body</p></template><span>light body</span></div>", options);
        System.out.println(result.content());
    }
}
```
